35.text: REINDEER-DRIVING. — Reindeer-fawns are usually broken in the first winter.

36.text: The herdsman selects for this purpose those that seem to be the least shy.

37.text: Sometimes the Lamut reindeer submits the first time it is put into harness, while

38.text: the Chukchee reindeer requires considerable time to be thoroughly broken.

39.text: The reindeer like the taste of urine. For this reason, every Chukchee herds-

40.text: man or reindeer-driver has tied to his belt or fastened to his sledge a small

41.text: leather urine-vessel (Fig. 7), which he uses to attract the reindeer that he

42.text: wishes to harness. When thoroughly tame, reindeer will come and drink
